suppress.notes: Spring Framework 6.2.19, fixed only in 7.0.9 (Boot 4). Not exploitable here. Each CVE needs a feature this service does not use: 47883 UrlHandlerFilter (not configured). 47884 XsltView (no views). 47885 WebFlux PartEventHttpMessageReader (no WebFlux). 47886 and 59283 SpEL evaluated on input (no ExpressionParser or EvaluationContext). 47887 UrlFileNameViewController (none). 47888 RSocket (absent). 47889 Jetty 12 reactive adapter (absent). 47890 and 59313 SSE with fragments or functional endpoints (none). 47891 Aalto XML on WebFlux (absent). 47892 WebFlux functional endpoints (none). 47893 WebFlux WebSocket (absent). 59280 FreeMarker (absent). 59281 HTML-escaped Errors rendered as HTML (no rendering). 59282 data binding of user-supplied property paths (JSON bodies through Jackson only; no ModelAttribute, DataBinder or InitBinder). 59314 Content-Disposition from untrusted input (filenames are reduced to [A-Za-z0-9._ -] by CaseworkerDocumentController.safeFilename, so CR/LF cannot reach the header).

Spring Security 6.5.11, fixed only in 7.x (Boot 4). Not exploitable here: 41707 DPoP (not used). 47841 WebAuthn (absent). 47842 AesBytesEncryptor (no Encryptors use). 59270 embedded UnboundID LDAP (absent). 59276 non-constant-time comparisons in token-handling components. Access tokens are verified by JWT signature (Nimbus), and CSRF, remember-me and one-time tokens are disabled or absent. Lower confidence than the others; re-check against the advisory's component list at the next review.

Spring Data JPA 3.5.13, fixed only in 4.x (Boot 4). Sort validation bypass with untrusted sort parameters. Not exploitable here: every Sort is built from a CaseSort name, an allowlist of published columns, or from constants. The caller's string never reaches Sort.

Spring Cloud Commons 4.3.3, fixed only in the 5.x train (Boot 4). Applies only when the writable /actuator/env endpoint is exposed. Not exploitable here: management.endpoints.web.exposure.include is health, info and prometheus.

Kotlin stdlib 1.9.25, brought in by the CCD SDK. Neither CVE affects this runtime: CVE-2020-29582 was fixed in 1.4.21, so this is a CPE false positive. CVE-2026-53914 is in the Kotlin compiler's build cache metadata, not the stdlib.
